correctness.evidence: Stock circuit checks passed. Two new kernel notices failed the health gate and ended the attempt.

limitations: The UART input overrun and USB hub warning appeared between the two qualification captures. They do not conclusively establish what altered the first transfer payload.
The hardened staging code passed local emulation and was never run against the board.

protocol.quality_gate: Existing read-only stock state and kernel-notice qualification
protocol.tokenizer: BOS plus two hex digit IDs per input UTF-8 byte. Useful outputs are byte IDs and exclude EOS.
protocol.warmup: Three exact requests per arm with loaded weights.

quality.evidence: No circuit comparison, timed workload or energy sample was produced.
